business_summary: yutori, Inc. engages in the planning, retail, and wholesale of clothing and cosmetic products in Japan and internationally. It offers its products under 9090, centimeter, MySugarBabe, YoungerSong, PAMM, BALLSY.BROTHERS, BADWAY, WudgeBoy, nemne, HTH, BrokenBase, BLESSU, Camphorwood, F-LAGSTUF-F, GULL, GOAT ESSENCE, HIROKI TSUZUKI, MARITHE +, codegraphy, shesame, minum, Her lip to, ROSIER by Herlipto and overprint brand names primarily through e-commerce sites. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
